See the `LICENSE` file at the repository root."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What is this"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The built-in `web_fetch` tool in DSH carries an SSRF guard: before fetching, it resolves the hostnam"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"e to IP addresses, and if any resolved address is a **non-public IP** (loopback, private, reserved r"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"anges, etc.), it rejects the request outright:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Under **Clash TUN (fake-ip mode)**, however, system DNS is taken over by Clash: every domain resolve"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"s to a **fake-ip reserved-range address** such as `198.18.0.0/15` (or `fdfe:dcba:9876::/48`), and th"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"e real connection is intercepted by the TUN virtual adapter and handed to Clash for proxying per its"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" rules. This is completely transparent to ordinary apps, yet it lands exactly on DSH's "non-public I"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"P" tripwire — with Clash TUN enabled, nearly every `web_fetch` request is rejected."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"This plugin removes that restriction: **any resolved IP is allowed**. The connection is still initia"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ted directly and the TUN adapter takes it over unchanged, so DSH works normally under Clash TUN."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"DSH's fetch pipeline is: the `web_fetch` tool → `ctx.web` (the WebRuntime service) → the local HTTP "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"fetch provider (`web-fetch-http`, id `http`). The IP check only happens inside the provider instance"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"'s `resolveAddresses` method (after DNS resolution, it verifies every answer is public unicast)."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"This plugin (a Cordis dynamic plugin, host side) **swaps that method in place** at runtime:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"1. **Zero change for public destinations**: the original resolver runs first; when every resolved ad"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"dress is public, behavior is identical to stock (including NAT64 checks, address pinning, redirects,"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" size/timeout caps).
2. **Only the "non-public" block is lifted**: if and only if the original logic"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" throws `WEB_BLOCKED_URL` with a message containing `non-public`, the plugin spawns a one-shot Node "},{"id":"p15s5","text":"child process through DSH's `subprocess` service and re-resolves via `dns.lookup(..., { all: true, o"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"rder: 'verbatim' })` through the **system resolver** (which, under Clash TUN, returns the fake-ip), "},{"id":"p15s7","text":"**allows every returned address**, and hands the address set to the stock address-pinned transport —"},{"id":"p15s8","text":" the TUN adapter intercepts the connection and Clash proxies it as usual.
3. IP literals (e.g. `127."},{"id":"p15s9","text":"0.0.1`, `[::1]`) are allowed as well; resolved answers are cached for 60 seconds per process to avoi"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"d spawning a child process repeatedly.
4. **The original method is restored when the plugin stops or"},{"id":"p15s11","text":" updates** — no residual side effects."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"No DSH source modification, no deployment config change, no second provider registration (so provide"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"r selection is untouched); the patch follows the plugin lifecycle exactly."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## One-click install"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The repository ships `install.ps1` (Windows PowerShell) and `install.sh` (macOS/Linux/Git Bash). One"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" command installs everything:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**What gets installed** (into `$DSH_HOME`, i.e. `$env:DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh`):"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| File | Purpose |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| `clash-tun-web-fetch-unlock.cjs` | Host-plane plugin module (a copy of the file in `payload/`) |
|"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" `cordis.patch.yml` | DSH's official home-directory user patch layer; the script idempotently append"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"s a marked block (`# >>> classtunwithdsh`) with one `insert` row that mounts the plugin into the hos"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"k (`# >>> classtunwithdsh`) with one `insert` row that mounts the plugin into the host composition |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"**Highlights**:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **Applies to every session of every profile** (mounted on the host plane) — no preset or DSH sourc"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"e edits;
- If the current profile has live patch reloading, it **takes effect immediately on save, n"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"o DSH restart needed**; otherwise it applies on the next DSH start;
- Idempotent: safe to run repeat"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"edly; uninstall removes exactly the marked block and nothing else;
- The scripts include an uninstal"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"l path that restores DSH's original behavior at any time."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Usage (in-session dynamic plugin, optional)"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Besides the one-click install, you can alternatively define a dynamic plugin in a session: use the f"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"unction body of `clash-tun-web-fetch-unlock.host.js` as `cordis_define`'s `code.host` (`idPrefix: "c"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"lash"`), then activate it with `cordis_run` — same effect, but it only lives in the current DSH proc"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"ess and must be re-loaded after a restart. Either way works; enabling both at once is safe (the patc"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"h carries ref-counting and restore protection)."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Verification"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Run each request once before and once after installing (the DSH Web GUI listens on `127.0.0.1:3080` "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"uest once before and once after installing (the DSH Web GUI listens on `127.0.0.1:3080` by default):"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| Request | Before | After |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| `web_fetch http://127.0.0.1:3080/` | `URL hostname "127.0.0.1" resolves to a non-public IP address"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"` | HTTP 401 (the GUI auth response — the connection actually happened) |
| `web_fetch http://localh"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"ost:3080/` | blocked the same way | HTTP 401 |
| `web_fetch https://example.com/` | HTTP 200 | HTTP "},{"id":"p31s4","text":"200 (public path, no regression) |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Notes"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- **This check is an SSRF guard.** Once lifted, `web_fetch` can reach local and intranet addresses. "},{"id":"p33s2","text":"Use it only on personal devices and trusted networks such as Clash TUN, and never let untrusted mode"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"l instructions steer fetches toward sensitive internal services.
- **Only the IP-resolution check is"},{"id":"p33s4","text":" lifted**: the URL scheme whitelist, credential rejection, redirect limits, byte/char/timeout caps, "},{"id":"p33s5","text":"address pinning, and every other transport-hygiene policy remain in force.
- The one-click install p"},{"id":"p33s6","text":"ersists with the DSH process (host plane) and survives restarts; after uninstalling (or removing the"},{"id":"p33s7","text":" patch row), restart DSH (or trigger a live reload) to restore the original behavior.
- Every allowe"},{"id":"p33s8","text":"d non-public destination is logged as `[clash-tun-web] allowed non-public destination: <host> -> <ip"},{"id":"p33s9","text":",...>` for observability."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Repository contents"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"| File | Purpose |"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"| `README.md` | This document (English) |
